$comment: Starter snippet sets (P3-T15), read-only; 'Copy to my snippets' makes an editable copy. {{name}} variables are filled in before sending (P3-T16). Config snippets enter and leave configuration mode themselves.

snippets.name: Access port
Trunk port
Enable SSH
snippets.body:
configure terminal
hostname {{hostname}}
ip domain-name {{domain}}
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 login local
end

snippets.name: NTP and syslog
Access port
Trunk port
Enable SSH
snippets.body:
configure terminal
hostname {{hostname}}
enable service ssh-server
ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
 login local
end

snippets.name: NTP and syslog
snippets.body:
configure terminal
ntp server {{ntp_server}}
ntp update-calendar
service timestamps log datetime
logging server {{syslog_server}}
logging trap informational
end
